<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-courses">Kitesurfing Lesson Prices — Punta Trettu, Sardinia<br></h2>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-layout-flex wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button has-custom-width wp-block-button__width-100"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button" href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdnDVdseelmv4RUUKpQPgN5vc5nAk8myYjAR6LInSTULscb-Q/viewform?usp=sf_link">Book your course now</a></div>
</div>
<p>Below you&#8217;ll find our full price list for private and semi-private kitesurfing lessons, from beginner packages to advanced single sessions.</p>
<p><strong>Notes:</strong> </p>
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Prices are per person</li>
<li><strong>Equipment included</strong>: Wetsuit, harness, helmet with radio, kite, board are included in your lesson price</li>
<li><strong>Refund Policy for no wind days</strong>: If lack of wind prevents or shortens your course, you&#8217;ll receive a proportional refund for unused hours.</li>
<li>A one-time sports club membership of <strong>€10</strong> (valid 12 months) is required to participate in lessons and use on-site facilities — this includes mandatory third-party liability insurance for kitesurfing in Italy.</li>
</ul>

<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Frequently Asked Questions</h4>
<p><strong>Do I need any prior experience?</strong> Not at all. Our beginner courses start from absolute zero. You bring a swimsuit, sunscreen and enthusiasm — we handle the rest.</p>
<p><strong>How many hours do I need to learn kitesurfing?</strong> Most students need between 8 and 12 hours to reach independent riding level. The Zero to Hero 10h package is specifically designed with this in mind.</p>
<p><strong>Is equipment included?</strong> Yes. Full Duotone &amp; ION equipment is included in every lesson — kite, board, harness, impact vest, wetsuit and radio helmet.</p>
<p><strong>Can two people share a lesson?</strong> Yes. Semi-private lessons (2 students, 1 instructor) are available at a reduced per-person rate. Both students share the kite during the session, which is standard practice in learning.</p>
<p><strong>What happens if there&#8217;s no wind?</strong> Lessons cancelled due to insufficient wind conditions are fully rescheduled at no extra cost. We&#8217;ll keep you informed via WhatsApp about the forecast before your session.</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Sleep, Kite, Eat, Repeat: The Ultimate Kite &amp; Sleep Experience 🤙</h2>
<p>Our Kite &amp; Sleep formula is the perfect way to experience Punta Trettu. Designed for kitesurf students, this package offers discounted accommodation rates directly on the Punta Trettu spot when combined with a kitesurfing course (minimum number of course hours required).<br>Stay where you ride, learn from sunrise to sunset, and enjoy a seamless kite experience without ever leaving the spot.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why you’ll love the Kite &amp; Sleep formula</h3>
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Live on the Spot:</strong> Wake up, check the wind from your window, and walk to your lesson. No commutes, no wasted time—just more hours on the water!</li>
<li><strong>Modern Comfort &amp; Privacy:</strong> After a day of salt and adrenaline, retreat to your private oasis. Our rooms are <strong>modern, sleek, and comfortable</strong>, featuring <strong>private bathrooms</strong> and <strong>independent outdoor entrances</strong> for total freedom and privacy.</li>
<li><strong>Fast-Track Your Skills:</strong> With 15 hours of pro-coaching spread over 5 days, you’ll be amazed at how quickly you’ll go from zero to hero.</li>
<li><strong>The &#8220;Loyalty Perk&#8221;:</strong> We love your dedication! To support your journey, all students enrolled in a Long-Term Course (15h/5 days) enjoy an <strong>exclusive 20% discount</strong> on our standard accommodation rates.</li>
<li><strong>The Vibe:</strong> When you aren&#8217;t in the water, you can kick back in our chill-out areas, share stories with fellow kiters, and enjoy the magical Sardinian sunsets.</li>
</ul>

  <p class="kite-rent__note">
    * Equipment rental and supervised sessions are available <strong>exclusively to riders certified as independent</strong> by one of our instructors or holding a valid IKO card (level 3 or above).<br>
    * Supervised Rental includes a dedicated rescue boat and on-water safety team &mdash; giving you the freedom to ride with full peace of mind.<br>
    * A one-time sports club membership of <strong>€10</strong> (valid 12 months, includes mandatory third-party liability insurance) is required to access all on-site services.<br>
